title: from_seurat_to_h5mu
description: Converts a Seurat file into an H5MU file.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.rds`

assay.description: Name of the assay to be mapped.

layers_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Layers to AnnData layers. 
If True, all layers will be mapped by name. 
If False, no layers will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

obs_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's observation columns to AnnData obs columns. 
If True, all observation columns will be mapped by name. If False, no columns will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

var_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's feature rows to AnnData var columns.
If True, all features will be mapped by name. If False, no features will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

uns_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Misc to AnnData uns. 
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

obsm_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Embeddings to AnnData obsm fields. 
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

varm_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Loadings to AnnData varm fields. 
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

obsp_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Graphs to AnnData obsp fields.
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

varp_mapping.description:
Mapping of Seurat's Misc to AnnData varp fields. 
If True, all fields will be mapped by name. If False, no fields will be mapped.
For custom mapping, provide a json key/value array with Seurat fields as values and AnnData fields as keys.

x_mapping.description: A string specifying Seurat's Layer to mapped to the .X slot, If not provided, no data will be copied to the .X slot.

modality.description: Name of the modality to be created.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
